articles.summary: Parsippany, NJ – October 19, 2026 – CorMedix Therapeutics (Nasdaq: CRMD) today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted for filing the supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) seeking approval of REZZAYO® (rezafungin for injection) for the prophylaxis of invasive fungal disease. The sNDA was submitted by Mundipharma, CorMedix’s global development partner, and […]
articles.title: CORMEDIX ANNOUNCES FDA ACCEPTANCE FOR PRIORITY REVIEW OF SUPPLEMENTAL NDA FOR REZZAYO® (REZAFUNGIN) FOR PROPHYLAXIS OF INVASIVE FUNGAL DISEASES
